text.name: vtpas_slip_label
text.text: Wheel slip for rear diff lock

text.name: vtpas_slip_tip
text.text: Wheel slip (%) above which the rear differential locks automatically (Enhanced Vehicle). It unlocks at half this threshold. Off = never.

text.name: vtpas_slipFront_label
text.text: Wheel slip for front diff lock

text.name: vtpas_slipFront_tip
text.text: Wheel slip (%) above which the front differential locks automatically (Enhanced Vehicle). It unlocks at half this threshold. Off = never.

text.name: vtpas_diff_tip
text.text: Auto = AutoSwitch locks the differentials on slip, picks 2WD / 4WD and releases the locks in turns. Manual = you handle everything; an engaged lock is never released, the tractor only turns up to its limit (wheels turned fully, it slides) (50 % rear, 20 % front, 10 % both). Key: Right Ctrl + Up arrow.

text.name: vtpas_tire_tip
text.text: With AutoDrive or Courseplay inflating and deflating are always automatic. This setting applies when you drive yourself: Automatic = inflated on roads, deflated in fields; Manual = you use the mod's key.

text.name: vtpas_notifDiff_tip
text.text: Shows a notification when a vehicle locks or unlocks its differentials.

text.name: vtpas_notifTires_tip
text.text: Shows a notification when a vehicle inflates or deflates its tires.

text.name: vtpas_alert_pct_tip
text.text: Shows a red message when a vehicle's wheel slip stays above this percentage for the set duration. Off = no alert.

text.name: vtpas_alert_sec_tip
text.text: Time (in seconds) the slip must stay above the threshold before the alert appears.

text.name: vtpas_alert_slip
text.text: %s: excessive wheel slip (%.0f%%) for more than %d s!

text.name: vtpas_diffdelay_tip
text.text: Time (in seconds) the wheel slip must stay above the threshold before the differentials lock automatically.

text.name: vtpas_tiredelay_tip
text.text: Minimum time (in seconds) between two pressure changes (inflate / deflate) to avoid rapid back-and-forth. Off = no delay.

text.name: vtpas_hintShow_tip
text.text: Shows the recommended speed range above the speedometer, updated continuously from the zone (field / road), tire pressure, soil type, soil moisture and wheel slip.

text.name: vtpas_hint_risk
text.text: Risk of getting stuck: min %d km/h, don't stop

text.name: vtpas_dur_tip
text.text: How long (in seconds) the message stays on screen.

text.name: vtpas_protectSeed_tip
text.text: Prevents Mud System Physics from erasing crops under the wheels when the vehicle reverses, and under the wheels of a seeder or planter. Other mud crop damage is kept.

text.name: vtpas_slipIcon_tip
text.text: Always shows (in a vehicle) the tractor seen from above (locked axles in red, 4WD driveline in green) with the slip of each wheel, or a single percentage per locked axle, movable with the mouse independently of the speed range. Colour: white, yellow from 10 %, orange at the differential threshold, red at the alert threshold.

text.name: vtpas_seedCoverFill_tip
text.text: Allows seeders and planters to be filled with seeds (big bag, pallet, trailer, auger, station) even when the hopper cover is closed. Off = base game behaviour.

text.name: vtpas_wetGrip_tip
text.text: MoreRealistic ignores the grip computed by Mud System Physics and Tractor Terrain Dynamics. This setting reduces wheel grip in fields depending on local moisture (from 20 %, maximum at 70 %) and soil type, and lowers MoreRealistic's 'wet field' grip by 20 %. At 60 % moisture: about -34 % (Beginner), -45 % (Easy), -56 % (Normal), -67 % (Hard), -78 % (Extreme).

text.name: vtpas_auto4wd_label
text.text: Drive: 2WD on asphalt and concrete, 4WD elsewhere

text.name: vtpas_auto4wd_tip
text.text: Automatically switches to two-wheel drive on hard surfaces (asphalt road, concrete) and to four-wheel drive everywhere else: fields, gravel or dirt tracks, grass (Enhanced Vehicle). In 2WD, if the rear axle slips beyond the threshold, 4WD engages first, then the differentials lock if slip continues; on the road it returns to 2WD once grip is back. A manual change is kept until the next ground change.

text.name: vtpas_autoOnHelper_label
text.text: Back to Auto with AutoDrive / Courseplay

text.name: vtpas_autoOnHelper_tip
text.text: In Manual, switches back to Auto as soon as AutoDrive or Courseplay takes over the tractor.

text.name: as_dual_store_function
text.text: On foot next to the rack, with a stopped tractor nearby: Right Ctrl + I. Full rack = mount dual wheels, empty rack = remove them. 30 min of work (15 min per tire), one tire every 15 min.

text.name: as_dual_mounting
text.text: Dual wheel mounting started: ready at %s

text.name: as_dual_unmounting
text.text: Dual wheel removal started: ready at %s

text.name: as_dual_none
text.text: No dual wheels available for this tractor

text.name: as_dual_stop
text.text: Stop the tractor to change wheels

text.name: as_dual_mp
text.text: Wheel change is only available in single player

text.name: as_dual_notractor
text.text: No tractor parked near the tire rack

text.name: as_dual_alreadytwin
text.text: This tractor already has dual wheels: the rack only provides dual wheels

text.name: as_dual_running
text.text: Wheel change already in progress: ready at %s

text.name: as_dual_rackempty
text.text:
This rack is empty (or incomplete).
Its tires are mounted on another tractor: remove them from that tractor first, or use a full rack.

text.name: as_dual_rackfull
text.text:
This rack is not empty: it cannot take the removed tires.
Use an empty rack.

text.name: as_dual_rackbusy
text.text: This rack is already used for another wheel change in progress.

text.name: as_dual_store_function_ar
text.text: 2 BKT Agrimax V-Flecto 650/65R42 tires on rims. On foot next to the rack with a stopped tractor nearby: Right Ctrl + I. Alone = rear dual wheels; with the front rack = front + rear dual wheels. 30 min of work (15 min per tire).

text.name: as_dual_store_function_av
text.text: 2 BKT Agrimax V-Flecto 540/65R30 tires on rims. Use it with the rear rack to mount front + rear dual wheels (Right Ctrl + I, on foot next to the racks).

text.name: as_dual_needar
text.text:
No full rear dual wheel rack near this tractor.
An empty rack means its tires are already mounted on another tractor: remove them from that tractor first, or buy a new rack.

text.name: as_dual_needav
text.text:
This tractor only exists with front + rear dual wheels.
Add a full front dual wheel rack near the tractor.

text.name: as_dual_needar_empty
text.text:
To remove the dual wheels, an empty rear rack is needed near the tractor to put the tires on.
A full rack cannot take more tires.

text.name: as_dual_needav_empty
text.text: This tractor also has front dual wheels: an empty front rack is also needed near the tractor.

text.name: as_dual_confirm_on
text.text:
Mounting dual wheels: %d tires, %d min of work (ready around %s).
The tractor will be immobilized during the change: you cannot enter it or start a helper. If it is moved, the change is cancelled.
Start mounting?

text.name: as_dual_confirm_off
text.text:
Removing dual wheels: %d tires, %d min of work (ready around %s).
The tractor will be immobilized during the change: you cannot enter it or start a helper. If it is moved, the change is cancelled.
Start removal?

text.name: as_dual_brand
text.text: No %s dual wheels for this tractor: change the tire brand in the workshop (available: %s)

text.name: as_dual_locked
text.text: Tractor immobilized: wheel change in progress (ready at %s)

text.name: as_dual_zone
text.text: Park the tractor inside the mounting area (rectangle on the ground next to the rack)

text.name: vtpas_adField_tip
text.text: Speed imposed on AutoDrive in a field, instead of its own setting. AutoDrive still slows down in turns and on arrival.

text.name: vtpas_adPath_tip
text.text: Speed imposed on AutoDrive on tracks (gravel, dirt, grass).

text.name: vtpas_adRoad_tip
text.text: Speed imposed on AutoDrive on paved roads. No limit: the tractor's maximum speed.

text.name: vtpas_rvBlockedNotif
text.text: Real Physics - Tire Wear: disabled and blocked by AutoSwitch (Use Your Tyres is the tire wear mod)

text.name: vtpas_sleepText
text.text: Choose how long to sleep: hours and days.

text.name: vtpas_windSway_tip
text.text: How strongly trees, crops and grass move in the wind. x1 = base game (at 57 km/h the base game only moves foliage like a breeze). The wind speed itself is unchanged.

text.name: vtpas_hudDedup_tip
text.text: Hides info other mods repeat (e.g. Enhanced Vehicle: Wear | Paint and Fuel). Those mods' settings are not changed.

text.name: vtpas_overdraft_tip
text.text: Buying and leasing allowed with a negative balance, down to this percentage of the resale value of what you own (purchased equipment, land, buildings). Off = base game.

text.name: vtpas_overdraftRate_tip
text.text: Interest charged every in-game day on the negative balance, prorated over the year (12 months). "Overdraft interest" line in Finances.

text.name: vtpas_coopPay_label
text.text: Co-ops pay at the end of the month

text.name: vtpas_coopPay_tip
text.text: Sales to co-ops (selling points whose name contains "coop") are marked "To be paid" in the register (Right Ctrl + R) and paid at the end of the month, "Co-ops" line in Finances. Editable list: modSettings/FS25_AutoSwitch/cooperatives.xml.

text.name: vtpas_hours_tip
text.text: Shop and selling points closed outside their opening hours. Exceptions per selling point: modSettings/FS25_AutoSwitch/horaires.xml (open="0" close="24": open 24/7).

text.name: vtpas_hours_shop_tip
text.text: Outside opening hours the shop can be browsed but buying, leasing, selling or building is refused.

text.name: vtpas_hours_sell_tip
text.text: Silos, mills, factories... Outside opening hours nothing is accepted; an AutoDrive truck waits until opening.

text.name: vtpas_hours_shopClosed
text.text: The shop is closed. Open from %s to %s.

text.name: vtpas_noOvertake_tip
text.text: Traffic cars stay behind tractors (AutoDrive or driven) on the road. They may pass when the tractor has been stopped for 10 s or has its hazard lights on.

text.name: vtpas_shopBlockTwins_tip
text.text: The shop and workshop no longer offer dual wheels: fit them with the tire pallets. Tractors already on duals keep them, and a pallet can switch them back to single wheels.

text.name: vtpas_weatherWidget_label
text.text: Mini weather next to the clock

text.name: vtpas_weatherWidget_tip
text.text: Shows the current weather and the next change left of the clock. Drag it with the mouse when the cursor is visible; a click opens the Weather window (Right Ctrl + M).

text.name: input_AS_REGISTER
text.text: Weighings and sales register: open / close

text.name: vtpas_wx_footer
text.text: Game forecast for the next %s. Amounts estimated from intensity. * = day not fully forecast

text.name: vtpas_beamEnabled_tip
text.text: Yes: headlight reach and brightness set below. No: base game headlights, no processing (better performance).

text.name: vtpas_light_road_tip
text.text: Low and high beams, roof lights. Reach and brightness together, from x1.1 to x2.5.

text.name: vtpas_light_workFront_tip
text.text: Work lights facing forward (and vehicle-specific work lights).

text.name: vtpas_light_beacon_tip
text.text: Light cast by the beacon lights.

text.name: vtpas_light_signal_tip
text.text: Turn signals, brake lights and reverse lights.

text.name: vtpas_light_other_tip
text.text: Interior lighting and lights that are in none of the game lists.

text.name: vtpas_tracksMax_tip
text.text: Number of tire track points kept and saved with the game. Fewer = less memory and processing.

text.name: as_help_intro_p1_text
text.text:
AutoSwitch makes Variable Tire Pressure, Enhanced Vehicle, MoreRealistic, Mud System Physics and Tractor Terrain Dynamics work together, without modifying any of them.
It handles tire pressure and differential locks on its own, makes grip realistic depending on the ground and its moisture, and adds handy windows: Weather, Fields and Register.
It also settles the conflicts between MoreRealistic, Use Your Tyres, DynamicDrivePro, Enhanced Vehicle and Recovery Winch: no mod is disabled.

text.name: as_help_intro_p2_text
text.text:
Key Right Ctrl + Up arrow, inside a vehicle. The mode is shown above the tractor.
• AUTO: AutoSwitch locks the differentials depending on wheel slip and picks 2WD or 4WD depending on the ground. • MANUAL: you handle differentials and 2WD / 4WD yourself. An engaged lock is never released, and the tractor only steers up to its limit (wheels turned fully, it slides).
When AutoDrive or Courseplay takes over, the tractor goes back to AUTO (adjustable).

text.name: as_help_intro_p3_text
text.text:
• Right Ctrl + Up arrow: AUTO / MANUAL mode (inside a vehicle) • Right Ctrl + M: Weather window • Right Ctrl + C: Fields window • Right Ctrl + R: weighing and sales Register • Right Ctrl + I: mount / unmount dual wheels (on foot, next to a tire rack)
All these keys can be changed in Settings > Controls.

text.name: as_help_intro_p4_text
text.text:
All settings are in Esc > Settings, AUTOSWITCH tab. Each line has a tooltip.
At the bottom of the tab: • the list of required mods, with a green tick (OK) or a red cross (missing, not activated or too old). A missing required mod does not block the game: only the features that depend on it are turned off; • "Logs in log.txt": one switch per feature, off by default. Errors are always written.
Required mods: VariableTirePressure, EnhancedVehicle, AutoDrive, Courseplay, MoreRealistic, moreRealisticXmlDatabank, MudSystemPhysics, TractorTerrainDynamics, DynamicDrivePro, RealisticHarvesting, MoistureSystem. Optional: Use Your Tyres (recommended) or Real Physics - Tire Wear for tire wear.

text.name: as_help_diff_p1_text
as_help_diff_p2_text
text.text:
The tractor switches to 2WD on asphalt and concrete, and to 4WD everywhere else: fields, gravel or dirt tracks, grass.
In 2WD, if the rear axle slips, 4WD engages first, then the differentials lock if it still slips. On the road, back to 2WD once grip returns.
A choice made by hand is kept until the next change of ground.

text.name: as_help_diff_p3_text
text.text: • In 4WD, steering is limited to 90 %. • Locks are released beyond 50 % of full steering (rear only), 20 % (front only) or 10 % (both). • With the wheels turned, a lock is refused: the message "Straighten the wheels" is shown.

text.name: as_help_diff_p4_text
text.text: In AUTO mode, when a plow is lowered (even behind another implement), the rear differential locks and stays locked while it is in the ground. In MANUAL, it is up to you.

text.name: as_help_diff_p5_text
text.text:
Machines without 4WD keep full steering, have no 2WD / 4WD and only their driven axle locks. The HUD then shows a combine or a forage harvester instead of the tractor.
The actual drivetrain of each machine is read after MoreRealistic (see the page "Files and advanced settings").

text.name: as_help_tires_p1_text
text.text:
With AutoDrive or Courseplay, tires (Variable Tire Pressure) are deflated in the field and inflated on the road, always automatically.
When you drive yourself, the "Tire pressure" setting decides: Automatic (as with a helper) or Manual (you use the Variable Tire Pressure key).
Variable Tire Pressure's automatic re-inflation at 30 km/h is disabled. At least 4 s separate two pressure changes (adjustable).

text.name: as_help_tires_p2_text
text.text:
The shop and the workshop no longer offer dual wheels (adjustable): they are mounted with tire racks, available in the shop and the construction menu. • Rear rack: 2 BKT 650/65R42 tires on rims. • Front rack: 2 BKT 540/65R30 tires, used with the rear rack for front + rear dual wheels.
1. Park the tractor, stopped, in the mounting area (rectangle on the ground next to the rack). 2. On foot, stand on the yellow marker. 3. Press Right Ctrl + I and confirm.
Full rack = mounting, empty rack = unmounting (the tires are put back on it). Allow 15 in-game minutes per tire; the tractor cannot be used during the work and the change is cancelled if it is moved. Single-player only.

text.name: as_help_tires_p3_text
text.text: The real width of dual wheels is used by Mud System Physics (less sinking) and they grip better on wet ground. A Variable Tire Pressure fix is applied for tires with brand variants.

text.name: as_help_tires_p4_text
text.text:
Tire wear is optional: Use Your Tyres (recommended) or Real Physics - Tire Wear. If both are activated, Use Your Tyres is used and the other one is blocked. Wear is applied on top of ground grip; on the road, a worn tire grips a little better (slick effect).
Muddy tires stay dirty much longer while driving (at least one hour on the road); water, rain and washing still clean them.

text.name: as_help_ground_p1_text
text.text:
MoreRealistic ignores the grip computed by Mud System Physics and Tractor Terrain Dynamics. AutoSwitch therefore lowers grip in the field depending on local moisture (from 20 %, maximum at 70 %) and the soil type.
Five levels: Beginner, Easy, Normal (default), Hard, Extreme. At 60 % moisture, the loss goes from about 34 % (Beginner) to 78 % (Extreme).

text.name: as_help_ground_p2_text
text.text: • Tires deflated in the field (Variable Tire Pressure): bonus capped at +15 % (+20 % with dual wheels). • Locked differentials: +4 % on the rear wheels, +3 % on the front wheels.

text.name: as_help_ground_p3_text
text.text:
The Precision Farming soil type counts in Mud System Physics moisture: sand dries quickly, clay stays wet.
When it rains on saturated ground, water gathers in the hollows of the terrain (fields, tracks, meadows; never on asphalt, concrete or in water) and forms visible puddles. They slowly disappear through seepage and evaporation.

text.name: as_help_ground_p4_text
text.text:
Mud System Physics mowed the grass under every wheel from 12 % moisture. Instead, trampled grass goes back one growth stage, with a chance that rises with speed and moisture; above 30 km/h it is cut short.
Tire tracks are kept with the savegame: they no longer disappear when the game is reloaded (60,000 points by default, adjustable).

text.name: as_help_ground_p5_text
text.text: • Implements stay still when stopped: no more bouncing caused by Mud System Physics and MoreRealistic. • Mud also slows down unbraked trailers and implements. • Seeding protection: when reversing, and under the wheels of a seeder or planter, the crop is no longer erased. • Seeders and planters can be filled with the lid closed. • Direct re-sowing is possible on crushed strips. • AutoSwitch's Mud System Physics and Tractor Terrain Dynamics settings are applied automatically.

text.name: as_help_hud_p1_text
text.text:
Inside a vehicle, a top view of the tractor is shown next to the speedometer: locked axles in red, 4WD in green, and the slip of each wheel (or a single percentage per locked axle).
Slip color: white, yellow from 10 %, orange at the differential threshold, red at the alert threshold. It can be moved with the mouse.

text.name: as_help_hud_p2_text
text.text: Above the speedometer, the recommended speed range is recomputed continuously depending on the area (field / road), tire pressure, the ground, its moisture and wheel slip. "RISK OF GETTING STUCK" warns you when you should not stop.

text.name: as_help_hud_p3_text
text.text: • Red slip alert when slip stays above 80 % for 5 s (threshold and duration adjustable, can be turned off). • Differential and tire notifications, with an adjustable display time. • "Hide duplicate displays" hides information that other mods repeat (for example Enhanced Vehicle), without changing their settings.

text.name: as_help_weather_p1_text
text.text:
Right Ctrl + M opens the Weather window, in four parts: now, next 24 h (in 3-hour slots), upcoming changes and next days.
These are the game's real forecasts: what is shown will happen. The game only gives a rain intensity: millimeters are estimated. A "*" marks a day that is not fully forecast.

text.name: as_help_weather_p2_text
text.text: Left of the clock, the mini weather shows the current weather, the next change, the wind and its direction. It can be moved with the mouse when the cursor is visible; a click on it ("Click me") opens the Weather window. Can be turned off.

text.name: as_help_weather_p3_text
text.text: Trees, crops and grass move more strongly in the wind (x2.2 by default; x1 = base game). Only the display changes: wind speed stays the game's.

text.name: as_help_fields_p1_text
as_help_fields_p2_text
text.text: The game keeps no dates: AutoSwitch records them itself since it was installed, once at least 10 % of the field has been worked (passes along the edge do not count). Before that, the cell says "before tracking". Dates are kept with the savegame.

text.name: as_help_fields_p3_text
text.text: • A month ("about Month 8"): harvest estimated from the crop's calendar. • "Ready": the crop can be harvested. • "Ready (best 5/7)": can be harvested, but the best stage is not reached yet (crops harvestable over several stages, such as silage maize). • "Best": best time to harvest. • After harvest: "Harvested" or the stubble.

text.name: as_help_fields_p4_text
text.text:
Game fields merged into one (a single outline of cultivated ground) are shown on a single line, for example "Field 12 (2 fields)". • A click on the blue cross unfolds the list of fields in the group. • A click on a field in this list makes it the main field (the one whose number is shown).
The outline is computed only once, spread over several frames so the game is not slowed down, then kept with the savegame.

text.name: as_help_register_p1_text
as_help_register_p2_text
text.text:
One page per year: the register opens on the current year; the < > arrows show previous years (nothing is erased).
The cross at the end of a line deletes it: click a second time to confirm.
The register is kept with the savegame.

text.name: as_help_money_p1_text
text.text:
You can buy or lease with the account in the red, up to 20 % of the resale value of what you own: purchased equipment (not leased), land and buildings (adjustable; Off = base game).
Interest is charged every in-game day on the negative balance: 10 % per year by default, spread over the days of the year. "Overdraft interest" line in Finances.

text.name: as_help_money_p2_title
text.text: Cooperatives paid at the end of the month

text.name: as_help_money_p2_text
text.text: A sale to a cooperative (selling point whose name contains "coop") works as usual, but the money does not come in straight away: it is marked "To be paid" in the register and the month's total is paid at the end of the month, "Co-ops" line in Finances. Can be turned off.

text.name: as_help_hours_p1_text
text.text:
• Shop: 8 am to 7 pm. Outside these hours, the shop can still be browsed, but buying, leasing, selling or building is refused. • Selling points (silos, mills, factories…): 6 am to 10 pm. Outside these hours, nothing is accepted; an AutoDrive truck waits on site for opening.
Hours adjustable in the AUTOSWITCH tab, and can be turned off.

text.name: as_help_hours_p2_text
text.text: The Sleep window offers two lists: hours (+0 to +23 h) and days (0 to 7). With days, you wake up at 8 am on the last day, plus the chosen hours. Days pass normally: crops, sales and wages are computed as usual.

text.name: as_help_road_p1_text
text.text:
• Traffic cars no longer overtake tractors (AutoDrive or driven) on the road. They pass if the tractor has been stopped for 10 s, is reversing or has its hazard lights on. • Their sensors are reduced to 80 % of their width: they no longer brake when meeting a tractor.
Also works with traffic added by Traffic Density Control.

text.name: as_help_road_p2_text
text.text: AutoSwitch sets AutoDrive's speed by the ground: 20 km/h in fields, 30 km/h on tracks, no limit on the road (adjustable). AutoDrive still slows down in turns and at arrival.

text.name: as_help_road_p3_text
as_help_files_p1_text
text.text: These files are created by AutoSwitch and can be corrected by hand, with the game closed: • transmissions.xml: drivetrain of each machine. "detected" is what AutoSwitch read; fill in "forced" with 4x4, front (front axle only) or rear (rear axle only) to impose yours. • cooperatives.xml: each selling point with coop="true" or "false", to correct what counts as a cooperative. • horaires.xml: opening hours of a specific selling point. -1 = hours from the menu; open="0" close="24" = open 24/7.

text.name: as_help_files_p2_text
text.text:
• AutoSwitch_fields.xml: dates and merged fields of the Fields window. • AutoSwitch_register.xml: weighings and sales of the register. • AutoSwitch_coop.xml: what the cooperatives still owe.
Tire tracks and the AUTOSWITCH tab settings are also kept with the game.
